verdict.rationale: AgentMail is built API-first. It claims inboxes can be created, managed and operated "entirely via API," agents can sign themselves up without the Console, and a public OpenAPI spec is live. Labels, lists, drafts, pods, permissions and webhooks are also documented as programmable resources. However, the evidence never states explicit API/UI parity, and billing add-ons are documented only as a Console action, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or matrix, API coverage of billing and account management, independent hands-on confirmation that no Console-only actions exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely via API.
For agents that sign themselves up programmatically, no Console or dashboard needed.
